human_review_text: The authors proposed a strategy of using synthetic data in AI model validation to overcome the issue of limited data in the training set. They generated synthetic liver tumors to demonstrate the performance for early cancer detection in CT volumes. Results were compared using either real or synthetic data in training, validation, and test sets.
